**BRIEFING NOTE: Riverside Tool Library Policy Application**

To process transactions accurately, adhere strictly to these operational rules. Count calendar days including closures; Sundays and April 15 are closed. Due dates falling on closures advance to the next open day. Returns deposited on closed days credit to that date.

Loan limits cap members at three items total, with a maximum of one Restricted item (e.g., chainsaws, etc.). Standard loans last 10 days; Restricted items last 5. New registered members under 30 days registration cannot borrow Restricted items. This restriction applies before renewal privileges.

Renewals require requests within the window: the due date and two preceding days. Extensions match original class length (10 Standard, 5 Restricted). Limits apply: Standard renews twice max, Restricted once. Requests fail if member has other overdue items, the specific item is overdue, or valid holds exist. Project Override allows bypassing hold limits but not suspension or overdue denials.

Hold shelf items allow 4-day collection periods from shelving. Shift to the next open day if closed. Fees accrue $1/day Standard, $4/day Restricted. Days 1-2 free; day 3+ charges all overdue days. Suspensions trigger at $20 unpaid balance and block all transactions. Items overdue 30 days incur a flat $75 forfeit charge, waiving late fees thereafter.

Priority logic: Payments, returns, collections, holds, checkouts, renewals occur on same dates if dates match. Apply these precedence rules immediately to resolve conflicts. Project Override extends loans by 7 days regardless of class.

**Riverside Tool Library Policy Briefing**

Apply these protocols strictly; do not reference the original specification text.

**Eligibility:** Members with unpaid balances of $20+ are SUSPENDED; block checkouts, renewals, holds, and Project Overrides. New members (<30 days) cannot borrow Restricted tools. Max loans: three, one Restricted maximum.

**Loan Terms:** Standard = 10 days; Restricted = 5 days. Add duration to checkout date. If result is a closed day (Sundays or April 15), shift to next open day. Include closures in overdue counts. Credit closed-day returns same date.

**Renewals:** Requests must occur within three days ending on the effective due date. Standard items renew twice; Restricted once. Denials apply if the member has any overdue item, the specific loan is overdue, or a valid hold exists. Project Override members bypass hold/limit denials but not overdue bars or suspension. Override extensions grant 7 days and count against renewal limits.

**Fees:** Accrue $1/day (Standard) or $4/day (Restricted). No fee if returned within first two overdue days; otherwise charge for full period including days 1-2. Items unreturned after day 30 become FORFEIT ($75 replacement fee, no further accrual). Fees post on return date.

**Holds:** Queue by date/member number. Collection period is 4 days from shelving (shifts if closed). Lapsed holds move to next queue member.

**Order of Operations:** If events coincide, process payments, then returns, collections, holds, checkouts, and renewals in that sequence. Precedence: Eligibility > Suspension > Overdue Denials > Override > Holds.

Subject: RIVERSIDE Tool Library Policy Briefing

Adhere to operational protocols. Sundays and April 15 are closed. Due dates falling on closures move to the next open day. Loan periods count calendar days including closures. Standard items (10 days); Restricted tools (chainsaws, 5 days). Members max three loans, one Restricted. New members <30 days barred from Restricted items.

Renewals accepted only within the window (due date ±2 days). Extensions match original term (Standard 10, Restricted 5), except Project Overrides grant 7 days. Max two Standard renewals, one Restricted. Renewals denied if member has other overdue items, item is overdue, or holds exist. Project Overrides bypass hold/limit denials but not suspension or overdue status.

Late fees: $1/day (Standard), $4/day (Restricted). Grace period applies to days 1–2; fees accrue from day 3 onwards if returned late. Holds place items on shelf for 4 days (including closures) before lapsing. Suspension triggers at unpaid balances ≥$20, blocking transactions until balance < $20. Items overdue 30+ days are forfeited ($75 replacement fee).

**Execution Order**
Prioritize suspension and eligibility checks before renewal overrides. Process same-day events: payments, returns, collections, holds, checkouts, renewals. All denials final per timestamp; re-request possible later. Returns in box count as returned that day. Closed-day deposits credited immediately.

When rules conflict, membership eligibility overrides renewal logic, suspension status. Project Overrides rank below suspension and overdue item checks. Calculate dates from effective due dates. Verify Build Project enrollment for Override privileges. Contact supervisor for exceptions.
